remarks: Located in a quiet cul-de-sac, this classic 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom Marrano-built center entrance home features an excellent floor plan with great light and generous indoor and outdoor space. You are welcomed with a covered double-door entry leading into a spacious foyer with hardwood floors. The main floor includes a den with French doors, a large living and dining area that opens to a rear deck with a gazebo, and a family room with a vaulted ceiling and a fireplace. The spacious kitchen offers updated solid wood cabinets, an island, a pantry, skylights, ceramic flooring, and access to both the back deck, the first-floor laundry room and open to the wonderful family room space. The second level includes an expansive primary bedroom with hardwood floors, beautiful natural light, a large en-suite bathroom, a walk-in closet and access to extra attic space. Three additional generous bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the upper level. The private backyard features a large deck with multiple access points, making it ideal for entertaining. The property also includes a full basement, a 600-square-foot garage, and is situated on a low-traffic street close to local conveniences. Home feels bigger than stated sq ftge. The owner is ready to sell, and a quick closing is possible if needed.
